description: Ministry of Industries - The Society Known as Siyambalagoda Nelumvila Viharastha ha Subhasadana samithiya Polgasowita.
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Industries exercising powers under the Societies Ordinance to authorize a society's purpose and limit the application of the ordinance. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters - specifically the application and modification of statutory provisions (Sections 3 & 4 of the Societies Ordinance) and includes a legal exemption from Section 5(4). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel change, and the primary focus is on regulatory authority and legal provisions rather than government structure or personnel matters.
